newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT-Telebras eases on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT-Telebras eases on profit-taking.

text.p: Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA eased on profit-taking Thursday following a recent rollercoaster ride of dips and rises.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Telebras were off 1/2 to 147. Volume was heavy, with the ADRs among the most active issues on the New York Stock Exchange.
"That's nothing," Jason Myers, senior vice president for Latin American equities at ING Barings, said of the drop.
"Think about it -- the stock was up $13 yesterday."

Telebras jumped from 135 to 148 Wednesday and is off a record high of 169-1/4 a week ago. It and other Brazilian ADRs have been hit by fears that turmoil among Asian and other emerging market currencies could lead to a Brazilian devaluation.
The worries over Brazil spilled over to hit other Latin American markets this week.
